page.layout: One printed page (818). Running head across the top. Below it a centred heading "Ab Galerio:", then two columns of short list lines (I–III left, IV–V right). Then a full-width paragraph with line numbers 10 in the right margin. Then headings and list-like lines in two columns for each province. Margin notes at left: "Ab Galerio" beside the top heading, and "Legiones ab Augusto constitutae" beside the Legiones heading. Line numbers 10, 20, 30, 40, 50 in the right margin.

main_text.head: Ab Galerio:
main_text.p: Has omnes Provincias Imperatores cum Augustus, tum qui eum sequuti, validissimis Legionibus munire iunt soliti, & in eas Legatos suos Procuratoresque mittere. 10 Legionum (subiectibo syllabum, praemonitos volens Lectores, adpositas Regiones urbesque signare Stationes, Primarum quidem xxv, ubi fuerint in Augusti distributione positae, reliquarum autem, ubi ab sequentibus Principibus primum institutae; quae omnes inde frequenter pro Imperatorum arbitrio Loca sua mutatle leguntur.
